svg.aria-label: Model ranking for 49 models: each column is one model's shrunken posterior mean of its within-env standardized score with a 95% interval, ordered left to right. A hollow diamond marks that model's best-across-runs capability ceiling, which labels a ceiling and never ranks. Field: reporting-level. 2 shaded columns with italic names are the held-out routing-based models. every model with the routing-based models in.
